music.title: Music
music.description: High-quality playback with a persistent queue.
music.playerDesc: Control music playback settings for this server.
music.enableDesc: Allow the bot to play music in voice channels via /play, /skip, /queue, etc.
music.howToDesc: Music is controlled via Discord slash commands.
music.cmdPlay: Play a song from YouTube, Spotify, or SoundCloud
music.cmdStop: Stop playback and clear the queue

redditFeeds.title: Reddit Feeds — Coming Soon
redditFeeds.description: Reddit notifications are temporarily unavailable while we complete Reddit's Data API approval. This feature will return automatically once access is granted.

rssFeeds.title: RSS Feeds
rssFeeds.description: Post a Discord notification whenever an RSS or podcast feed publishes a new item. Checks every 5 minutes. No API key required.

twitterFeeds.title: X / Twitter Feeds
twitterFeeds.description: Post a Discord notification whenever a tracked account publishes a new tweet. Checks every 5 minutes.
twitterFeeds.notice: X/Twitter alerts require a Bearer Token (TWITTER_BEARER_TOKEN) set in the bot's .env file. A free X Developer account with a Basic app is sufficient. Without it, Twitter alerts will be silently skipped.

streamAlerts.title: Stream Alerts
streamAlerts.description: Notify the community when creators go live or post — Twitch, Kick, YouTube, X, RSS.

counting.title: Counting
counting.description: One number at a time — keep the chain alive.
counting.notInstalled: The Counting addon is not installed.
counting.notInstalledHelp: Go to <manager>Addon Manager</manager> to install it, then configure the counting channel here.
counting.liveStatsDesc: Current state of the counting game in this server.
counting.configDesc: Settings are managed via the Addon Manager. Use the Reset button to restart the count.
counting.allowSameUser: Allow same user twice in a row:

members.title: Members
members.noneMatching: No members found matching your search.

polls.title: Polls
polls.description: View and manage polls created in your server.
polls.createdVia: Polls are created in Discord using the <cmd>/poll</cmd> slash command.
polls.empty: No polls found for this server.

announcements.title: Bot Announcements
announcements.description: Receive update announcements directly in your server
announcements.sectionDesc: When enabled, Arken Bot will post staff-crafted update announcements in your chosen channel. You can disable this at any time.
announcements.enableDesc: Receive bot update posts in this server
announcements.mustSelect: You must select a channel to receive announcements.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Growth, activity, and engagement for your server.
analytics.empty: No historical data yet. Analytics data is collected daily and will appear here after the first full day.

auditLog.title: Dashboard Audit Log
auditLog.description: Every change made to this server's settings through the web dashboard — who, what, and when.
auditLog.emptyDesc: Entries appear here whenever an admin saves settings, creates alerts, or deletes configuration through the dashboard.

inviteTracker.title: Invite Tracker
inviteTracker.settingsDesc: Track how many members each user has invited to the server.
inviteTracker.enableHelp: Enable invite tracking to start recording invite data. Uses your bot's existing invite permissions.
inviteTracker.leaderboardDesc: Click a row to see which members joined through that person's invite.
inviteTracker.noDataEnable: Enable invite tracking above to start.

selfRoles.title: Self-Assignable Roles
selfRoles.description: Members can claim roles themselves with <assign>/selfassignrole</assign> and drop them with <remove>/selfremoverole</remove>.
selfRoles.addDesc: Select a server role and give it a short name that members will type in the command.
selfRoles.currentDesc: Members can claim any of these roles at any time.
selfRoles.empty: No self-assignable roles yet. Add one above.

verification.title: Verification Gate
verification.description: Require new members to verify before accessing the server.
verification.infoCard: When enabled, new members receive the Pending Role and can only see the verify channel. Clicking Verify gives them the Member Role and access to the rest of the server.
verification.gateDesc: Enable the verification system for new members.
verification.enableDesc: New members must verify before accessing server channels
verification.rolesDesc: Configure the roles and channel used for verification.
verification.pendingRoleHelp: Role given to new members when they join (pre-verification).
verification.memberRoleHelp: Role given after a member verifies successfully.
verification.verifyChannelHelp: Channel where the verify button panel is displayed.
